title.narrative: Emergency mobile medical nutrition clinics for the displaced in Al-Hudaydah Governorate (Phase VI)

description.narrative: (178,160) IDPs received primary health care / (4200) children and women obtained therapeutic feeding services / (960) IDPs received immunization services / (12,000) women received reproductive health services / (8000) boys and girls obtained Medical services for children / A number of (30,000) displaced people obtained health awareness and education and advancement in the camp environment / Providing dressing and follow-up services to a number of (8000) and reducing complications and infections with the provision of medical referral service for (150) patients / Continuing to provide treatment and diagnostic services to a number of 178, 160 beneficiaries/ (15,000) cases received diagnosis and treatment services for epidemic diseases.
Preserving the lives of the displaced by providing health and nutrition services in Al Hudaydah Governorate and its districts
Saving life, maintaining its continuity, limiting the spread of diseases and epidemics, and securing basic emergency health and nutrition services for the displaced.
